instagram.caption:
The leftover prescription.
The Medicine Cabinet or Wall Storage in the Primary Bathroom. To hold the medicine and first aid you would need tonight, and nothing you stopped needing years ago.

What done looks like:
1. Three labeled bins
2. Stomach and cold
3. Each holding only in-date items. Prescriptions grouped by the name on the label
4. The first aid bin small enough to carry one-handed to whoever is bleeding

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success medicine cabinet or wall storage.
